paginationFilterOrder.order: GET principals ORDER BY created_at,user_id COLLATE BINARY; each credentials ORDER BY id COLLATE BINARY. No filter/cursor/offset. Not applicable to action receipts/HEAD.
paginationFilterOrder.activeCount: enabled NULL counts active; expiry does not reduce count. No promise this count represents effective grants/valid credentials.

revisionConfirmationCapabilities.confirmation: POST confirm must be boolean true, including recover. GET no confirmation. HEAD executes no action.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.revision: No revision token, If-Match or optimistic version input; headers do not implement a revision check. Immediate control writer transaction provides serialization.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.currentAuthority: Human-only profile-bound signed cookie, matching workspace and verifier key; current unexpired native session. GET Current; all POST including Recover Fresh (age strictly <600000ms). Session max lifetime 43200000ms. Native current user exists, email verified, MFA enabled, exactly one verified factor, current session and latest workspace role workspace_owner; rechecked in same writer transaction.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.originCsrf: Host exactly configured authority as a single header. POST Origin required exactly configured origin; GET Origin may be absent but if present must exactly match. sec-fetch-site absent or exactly same-origin/same-site/none. Duplicate headers fail one(). No separate CSRF token input. No service-key/Bearer fallback.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.rate: GET and all four POST map to same ServiceLifecycle rate key: 10 per 60s per canonical peer. Timestamp advances on admitted attempts (cooldown), IPv4-mapped normalized; IPv6 /64 grouped; local verified Unix uid if used. Map cap 4096, mutex failure denies, retry-after:60. Auth parsed after rate and before semaphore/body. Four shared workers, permit held through blocking work even after HTTP disconnect.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.pipeline: Host lifetime/workspace admission -> application connection fence -> BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> non-List workspace transfer require_business_write active -> cookie_session resolve Current/Fresh -> authorize + owner role -> checked inventory/history/action -> prepared bounded receipt -> commit (List rollback). No grants supplied here; company grants/permissions are separate, and credential issuance alone is not company authorization.
revisionConfirmationCapabilities.nativeCLI: List requires --cookie-file, no --confirm; all four mutations including recover require --confirm AND inner confirm:true. globalPreparation.policy: Before run/remote::run, local_binding::prepare extracts --local-profile PATH or --local-profile=PATH until --; duplicate/empty/missing profile or simultaneous --server[=] or --allow-loopback-http[=] refuses exit2 JSON stdout. parseProtocol.argv: Exactly one command, flags may surround it. Value flags require next nonempty token not starting --; duplicate value flags rejected. Boolean --allow-loopback-http/--confirm/--preview-reviewed/--open reject duplicates. Unknown flag or extra positional rejected. Post-preparation remote parser has no --json, --flag=value or -- terminator support. The global preprocessor separately accepts attached --local-profile=PATH before this parser. --help is special only as the sole remote argument.
parseProtocol.stdin: Read at most8193 bytes, reject >8192; exact bytes forwarded once. serde_json Value duplicate keys collapse locally, but original bytes forwarded: strict server rejects duplicate recognized fields. Unknown fields/null/wrong types rejected locally. DisplayName pretrim raw byte minimum1; trimmed nonblank <=120 scalars and <=1024 bytes, no controls. IDs1..4096 bytes, nonblank/no controls. UUID trimmed case-insensitive version1..8/RFC variant. Expiry integer86400..31536000; absent server default7776000, no CLI-injected default.
parseProtocol.transport: Each SDK send fetches public bounded1MiB manifest without credentials, then admits method/path/rust-http-v1. Sends protocol1/manifest/profile and Origin; no redirects/proxies/ambient cookies/retries; connect10s,total30s. HTTPS origin required or explicit allow-loopback-http with literal loopback IP. No path/query/fragment/userinfo. Global main/local_binding first supports explicit --local-profile or attached --local-profile=PATH, with verified Unix socket and exact origin; the post-preparation remote parser sees injected server/loopback flags. No TCP fallback.
parseProtocol.response: Read: non2xx -> server_refused (including5xx); chunks -> transport; >16MiB/invalid JSON -> protocol. Write with body: send/chunks/5xx/>16MiB/invalid JSON -> outcome_unknown; other non2xx -> server_refused. Auth uses separate65,536-byte reader and cookie checks; its5xx/chunks/invalid body/cookie -> outcome_unknown. Preflight errors -> protocol before dependent dispatch. Server refusal payloads are never echoed.
parseProtocol.localFile: Cookie opened descriptor must be regular <=8192 bytes and Unix mode &077 ==0; bounded read, UTF8, trim trailing CR/LF, nonempty no controls. Cookie symlinks/hardlinks are not explicitly refused. Service key (me/companies only): refuses symlink/nonregular, Unix hardlinks and public mode; before/open dev+ino match,4098 file bytes, exactly optional final LF/CRLF, key1..4096 bytes no trim differences/control; errors omit key/path.
